<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

### Verdict/Confidence/Severity/Task Type

| Field | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Confirmed |
| Confidence | Confirmed |
| Severity | Medium |
| Task Type | Correctness / focused regression |

### What Was Claimed

The `npm tst` alias can bypass required test-script validation in verification preflight (source finding `VP-003`, PR `#110`).

### What We Found

`packageScriptName()` recognizes package managers, `test`, `run`, and `run-script`, but only maps the direct command token `test` to the package script `test`. The npm aliases `t` and `tst` therefore return no script name. `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands()` consequently skips `assertPackageScript()` and can accept a required alias command in a package directory without a `test` script.

The existing adapter tests cover `npm test`, executable availability, and cwd containment, but do not cover npm aliases. A fixture with a package manifest lacking `scripts.test` and an available npm executable reproduces the bypass for `npm tst`.

### Root Cause

Direct package-manager command aliases are not normalized to the canonical `test` package script before package-script validation.

### Affected Files

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` — normalize npm test aliases.
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` — add focused alias regression coverage.

### Evidence

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts:119-128` maps only `command === "test"` and otherwise returns `undefined` for direct aliases.
- `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands()` invokes `assertPackageScript()` only when `packageScriptName()` returns a script.
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` has no `t` or `tst` command cases.
- Issue `#113` records fingerprint `941c201d…`, finding `VP-003`, and requires exact remediation-head re-review.

### History Findings

The finding reports that an earlier remediation recognized npm aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` and added regression coverage, but the frozen integration base currently retains only the `test` mapping. No unrelated history or scope is needed for this fix.

### Recommendation

Map npm's direct test aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` to the canonical `test` script, preserving existing `run`/`run-script` handling and non-package-manager behavior. Add focused tests proving each alias fails closed when `scripts.test` is absent and succeeds when it is present.

### Related Issues

- Source issue: `#94`
- Source PR: `#110`
- Remediation issue: `#113`
- Finding: `VP-003`

### Decomposition Assessment

This is a single-writer, two-file correctness change. It does not require decomposition, a product decision, or an authority decision.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Reproduce the bypass on the frozen base using a missing-`test` fixture.
- [ ] Normalize npm `test`, `t`, and `tst` aliases to `test` before validation.
- [ ] Add focused regression coverage for alias rejection and valid-package acceptance.
- [ ] Run the required `check` verification command.
- [ ] Re-review the exact remediation head.

<!-- INVESTIGATION:COMPLETE -->

<!-- FORGE:CONTRACT -->
## Builder Contract

### Objective

Ensure required package-manager verification commands cannot bypass package-script validation when they use npm's direct test aliases. Normalize `test`, `t`, and `tst` to the canonical `test` script while preserving existing command and path safety behavior.

### Allowed Paths

- `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts`
- `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts`

### Forbidden Changes

- Do not change `.forge/config.json`, policy parsing, or verification execution.
- Do not alter cwd containment, symlink, executable, manifest, or JSON validation rules.
- Do not add arbitrary package-manager commands or broaden alias handling beyond the focused direct test aliases.
- Do not modify GitHub, workflow, review, branch, or authority behavior.
- Do not change files outside the two allowed paths.

### Invariants

- Required commands still require an available executable before script validation.
- A package-manager command with a direct test alias validates `scripts.test` in the selected package manifest.
- `run` and `run-script` continue selecting their explicit script argument.
- Non-package-manager commands continue to skip package-script validation.
- Missing or empty `scripts.test` remains a fail-closed preflight error.

### Deliverables

- Normalize direct npm test aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` in `packageScriptName()`.
- Add focused regression coverage showing each alias rejects a package without `scripts.test` and accepts one with the script.

### Acceptance Mapping

| Check | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| VP-003 reproduction | Alias cases use a package manifest without `scripts.test` and assert the existing preflight error. |
| Root-cause fix | `packageScriptName()` maps `test`, `t`, and `tst` to `test`. |
| Regression coverage | Parameterized adapter tests cover all aliases and valid-package acceptance. |
| Verification | Run the required named `check` command. |

### Out of Scope

- Other package-manager alias semantics.
- Changes to tracked verification policy or CI configuration.
- Runtime execution of npm or any new command parsing behavior.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT -->
## Implementation Context

### Relevant History

- Issue `#113` carries source finding `VP-003` from PR `#110` and requires exact remediation-head review.
- The frozen base contains the preflight hardening introduced for package cwd/script validation, but the direct `t`/`tst` aliases are not normalized.

### Callers and Data Flow

- `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands()` iterates required policy commands.
- `executableAvailable()` validates the configured executable.
- `packageScriptName()` identifies package-manager script invocations.
- `assertPackageScript()` reads the selected package's `package.json` and fails closed when the script is absent.

### CI Surface

- `.forge/config.json` marks `check` as required and binds it to `npm run check`.
- `check` runs strict TypeScript validation followed by all `test/**/*.test.ts` tests.
- The focused adapter suite is the regression surface; no policy files are changed.

### Prior Findings

- `VP-003` is a confirmed medium-severity correctness finding: `npm tst` can skip test-script validation.
- The issue evidence states that aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` were expected to be recognized; current code only recognizes `test`.

### Hazards

- Mapping only one alias would leave the same bypass through another direct alias.
- Changing generic `run` argument scanning could regress existing flag handling.
- Tests must prove both rejection of a missing script and acceptance of a valid package without invoking npm.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT:COMPLETE -->

<!-- FORGE:ARCHITECT -->
## Architecture Plan

1. Update `packageScriptName()` so direct test aliases `test`, `t`, and `tst` return the canonical script name `test`, while leaving explicit `run` and `run-script` resolution unchanged. (VP-003 reproduction, Root-cause fix)
2. Extend `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` with table-driven alias cases against the existing fixture and assert the existing fail-closed error for a package lacking `scripts.test`; retain a successful package case. (Regression coverage)
3. Run the trusted `check` verification command and inspect the resulting diff for contract compliance. (Verification)

<!-- FORGE:ARCHITECT:COMPLETE -->
